title: Mixture of Training: Recombining Small-Scale Scaffolded Pretraining Runs into a Larger Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2608.13277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We ask whether language-model pre-training can be decomposed into smaller, independently trainable jobs that can later be recomposed into a coherent larger model. We introduce Mixture of Training (MoT), a scaffolded modular pre-training procedure that partitions a target Transformer into contiguous layer blocks, trains each block inside a frozen pretrained aligner scaffold, and then recomposes the trained blocks with an optional short end-to-end adaptation pass. On a 1.3B-parameter Gemma-style model trained on C4, MoT provides a small-scale proof of mechanism: independently trained depth slices can be recomposed into a usable language model, and a quality-parity schedule reaches the same reported perplexity as the monolithic baseline. This parity setting processes more aggregate tokens and has a shorter idealized layer-equivalent critical path after aligner preparation; its effective compute advantage depends on reusing the aligner acr

translated_title: 训练混合：将小规模脚手架预训练运行重组为更大的语言模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13277v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们探讨语言模型预训练是否可以分解为更小的、可独立训练的任务，并随后重组为连贯的更大模型。我们引入了训练混合（MoT），一种脚手架式模块化预训练流程，将目标Transformer划分为连续的层块，在冻结的预训练对齐器脚手架中训练每个块，然后通过可选的短端到端适应阶段重组训练好的块。在C4上训练的1.3B参数Gemma风格模型中，MoT提供了小规模机制验证：独立训练的深度切片可以重组为可用的语言模型，且质量对等计划达到与单体基线相同的报告困惑度。这种对等设置处理更多聚合令牌，并在对齐器准备后具有更短的理想化层等效关键路径；其有效计算优势取决于重用对齐器。
tldr: 本文提出训练混合（MoT）方法，将语言模型预训练分解为独立训练的层块，通过冻结对齐器脚手架重组为更大模型，在1.3B参数模型上达到与单体训练相同的质量，同时缩短关键路径并利用对齐器重用优势。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Mixture of Training (MoT), which decomposes language model pretraining into independently trainable layer blocks recombined via a frozen aligner scaffold, achieving quality parity with monolithic training on a 1.3B model while reducing critical path and leveraging aligner reuse.
